title: ha/dr: automation for multi-AZ failover & restore drills (installer, Helm, Terraform, runbooks-as-code)
author: Diego Ramos
release_notes: Automates multi-AZ failover and restore drills for private deployments: adds runbooks-as-code, Terraform modules and Helm chart hooks for failover, and upgrade/rollback tooling. No user-facing API changes.
description:
Motivation: private deployments (VPC/on-prem) need repeatable, testable HA and DR drills. Customers were running manual procedures that are error-prone and not codified. This PR carries the automation work to: 1) enable multi-AZ failover orchestration, 2) provide Terraform and Helm changes to support failover-safe upgrades, and 3) add runbooks-as-code for restore drills and post-failover validation.

What this PR includes (summary): 
- Terraform: new modules (terraform/modules/ha) to provision multi-AZ resources and promote standby zones, plus outputs consumed by the installer.
- Helm: hooks and templates (charts/private-installer) that drain nodes, snapshot persistent volumes, and run post-deploy validations.
- Installer: orchestration glue in the private-installer CLI to run 'drill start|failover|restore' with dry-run and playbook modes.
- Runbooks-as-code: runbooks/ha-dr/* in Markdown with executable verification tasks (sh/curl/kubectl snippets) and CI checks.
- Upgrade/rollback tooling: new 'installer upgrade --canary' flow with automatic rollback on degraded health checks.
- Tests: unit tests for Terraform module inputs, Helm integration smoke tests, and an end-to-end DR drill integration test (runs in the perf-canary infra).

Commits (high-level):
- initial: add terraform ha modules and basic docs
- installer: add drill CLI and orchestration glue
- helm: add pre-install/post-install hooks and PV snapshot helpers
- runbooks: add runbooks-as-code, test harness, and CI linting
- tests: add integration test harness and fix race conditions in orchestration

Files changed (high level):
- terraform/modules/ha/* (new)
- charts/private-installer/templates/hook-*.yaml
- cmd/private-installer/drill.go
- runbooks/ha-dr/* (Markdown + verification scripts)
- tests/integration/drill/*

Testing & validation: 
- CI runs include terraform validate, helm lint, unit tests, and the integration drill in an isolated perf-canary namespace. The integration test was marked flaky initially; added retries and fixture isolation. 
- Ran a staged restore drill in a staging account with 3 AZs; metrics and alerts were validated with Redwood Console dashboards.

Rollout plan: feature is behind an opt-in flag in the installer by default. Canary rollout to Dedicated customers who opt into the early-access DR automation. Documentation and runbook links added to the private-installer README and the Operator Guide.

Backward compatibility: there are no breaking API changes for the public hosted API. Terraform modules are additive and the installer defaults are unchanged unless the --drill flag is used.

Related: references ENG-4281 for design doc, SRE-237 for production runbook updates, SUP-551 for a customer restore escalation that motivated automation.

changelog_entry: Added automation for multi-AZ failover and restore drills: Terraform modules, Helm hooks, installer drill CLI, runbooks-as-code, and integration tests. Opt-in behind installer flag; no breaking changes.
examples:
# start a failover drill (canary)
private-installer drill failover --drill-id=canary-1 --target-az=az-3 --canary

# perform restore after failover
private-installer drill restore --drill-id=canary-1 --from-snapshot=snap-20260226-01
